review_method: Deterministic schema and provenance audit plus direct inspection of three primary authored sources.

evidence.source_review: Every claim resolves to one or more authored repositories or posts.
evidence.confidence_review: Repeated built patterns are high confidence; the abstraction objection is labeled inference at medium confidence.
evidence.copyright_boundary_review: Only metadata and original paraphrases are stored.
evidence.validity_window_review: The snapshot is bounded to 90 days and every dated source precedes it.

residual_limits: This narrow lens covers ML implementation and evaluation, not every topic in the author's work.
No participation or endorsement is implied.
